crates-io/fax

fax

Decoder and Encoder for CCITT Group 3 and 4 bi-level image encodings used by fax machines TIFF and PDF.

README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

CCITT Group 3 and 4 image encodings.

Currently supported:

  • de- and encoding group 4 images
  • decoding group 3 images
